about: Precomputed explanations per notice id and translation version ("correct" / "flawed"). Phrases (qe.spans[].text, alignment[].ko / .en) must be copied exactly from the Korean text or the matching English translation in notices.json; add "occurrence" (1-based) if a phrase appears more than once. Missing notices, versions or fields show as 'pending' in the app. Run `npm run check-data` after editing. Entries with "_mock": true are placeholders written by hand for UI testing, NOT real model output.

correct.backtranslation:
Check-in begins at 3 p.m. and check-out is by 11 a.m. Please make sure to shower before going into the pool. The pool is on the fourth floor and is open from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Breakfast is served at the restaurant on the third floor from 7 a.m. to 10 a.m.

Please return your room key to the first-floor front desk when you check out. The Wi-Fi password is written on the card on the desk in your room. If you have any questions, please call the front desk at any time.
correct.rationale: The translation is accurate. Times (check-in 3 p.m., check-out 11 a.m., pool 7 a.m.–9 p.m., breakfast 7–10 a.m.) and floors (pool on 4, restaurant on 3, front desk on 1) match the source. The pool rule correctly says to shower before entering ("들어가시기 전에" = before entering).

correct.backtranslation:
This drug is the antibiotic amoxicillin. From today, take one capsule after breakfast, lunch and dinner for two weeks. Even if you feel better, you must take it every time for the whole period.

If you get bad diarrhea or hives, stop taking it and call your doctor immediately. Drink enough water while taking this medicine. Keep the medicine somewhere cool and away from sunlight. Amoxicillin belongs to the penicillin family, so if you have a penicillin allergy, make sure to tell the pharmacist before you take it.
correct.rationale: The translation is faithful. The dose (one capsule after each of three meals), the two-week course, the instruction to finish the course, the warning signs (severe diarrhea, hives), storage, and the penicillin-allergy warning all match the source.

correct.backtranslation:
Thank you for reserving our guesthouse. You can check in from 4 p.m. until 10 p.m. Even with a reservation made in advance, you cannot check in unless you show ID.

The shared kitchen can be used from 8 a.m. to 11 p.m.; please wash the dishes you used yourself. After 11 p.m., please be quiet for other guests. Towels are replaced every two days. The Wi-Fi password is on the notice board in the living room. Luggage can be stored for free until 6 p.m. on the day you check out.
correct.rationale: The translation is accurate. Check-in hours, the requirement to show ID even with a booking, kitchen hours, quiet hours, towel changes, and luggage storage all match the source.
